reason: The locked half is correct: `scheduleSMS` returns undefined when locked (twilioProvider.ts:92-95), which hits the new else-branch `retryCount + 1` (scheduleSMSReminders.ts:178-186), and the new `retryCount > 1` delete (scheduleSMSReminders.ts:38-42) removes the reminder after two failed runs, where before it stayed unscheduled until `scheduledDate`. The rate-limit half is overstated: `checkSMSRateLimit` does not throw on a limit hit, it only changes the lock state (checkRateLimitAndThrowError.ts:40-45), so it reaches the catch increment only if that update itself errors.
